notes.title: Nominate Street Defenders for the Steam Awards
notes.notes:
Hello, Street Defenders fans! 

We're thrilled to announce that Street Defenders, your favorite tower defense game, is entering the Steam Awards! If you’ve enjoyed battling hordes of zombies and monsters, strategically upgrading your towers, and saving the streets from chaos, this is your chance to show your support.


Nominate Street Defenders in the Best Game You Suck At category or any other category you think fits! Your votes mean the world to us and help our game get the recognition it deserves.


Thank you for being part of our journey. Let’s defend the streets and claim victory together! 

Nominate now and help us bring the award home!
